description: This file defines the AssignNameExpression class within the Twig templating engine. It handles the assignment of variable names in Twig expression parsing, including deprecation warnings and syntax error checks.

classes.name: AssignNameExpression
classes.description: Represents an assignable name expression in Twig templates, with logic to handle deprecated class usage and syntax validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AssignNameExpression with a variable name and line number, triggers deprecation warning if deprecated class is used, and throws syntax errors for reserved names.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to assign the name to the Twig context array.
